speaker: Sheldon
text: It's close. Yeah, still funny, Raj.

speaker: Raj
text: God, I love the smell of paintballs in the morning. What about the creek bed?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Eh, the pharmacology department controls that, and they're all hopped up on experimental steroids.

speaker: Raj
text: That's it, they're doomed. I think the time has come to acknowledge we are paying the price for some of us failing to attend my physics department paintball strategy meeting.

speaker: Sheldon
text: My mom has spider veins. I had to take her to the laser clinic. And I told you I wanted to see a doctor's note.

speaker: Raj
text: We need a plan. How about Operation Hammer of the Gods?

speaker: Leonard
text: There's no way we can get to the ridge. The chemistry department has us completely cut off. I forget. Which one is Hammer of the Gods?

speaker: Raj
text: We hide behind the dumpsters in the parking lot and ambush people when they come to pee.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, go. The dumpsters are deep in astronomy department territory.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, that shouldn't be a problem. Venus is up during the day. They're probably just all staring at the sky.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Alright, what we need now is a tactical retreat. Did you see the episode of Stargate where they found themselves on a planet with a culture based loosely on Earth, Athens, and Sparta? Not important.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, Raj, and I are going to burst out the door and run away. Howard will cover us.

speaker: Raj
text: Why don't I run away and you cover me?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Because you chose your mother's veins over victory. On three. One, two.
